blurb: District Brewing serves in-house craft beer and Detroit-Style pizza baked in rectangular pans with thick, airy, and crispy crusts. They have three locations in Mt. Vernon (also the brewery), Ferndale, and Lynden, featuring indoor and outdoor gathering spaces, an arcade, and private event rooms. The brewery offers a rotating lineup of house-made beers and a curated selection of guest taps.
